items.title: Justice Hill: Season-high rushing yardage total
items.body_text: Hill rushed nine times for 85 yards and a touchdown and brought in all three targets for seven yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Mark Andrews: Two catches in Week 9 loss
items.body_text: Andrews secured both targets for 19 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Joe Fagnano: Modest numbers in starting role
items.body_text: Fagnano completed 10 of 18 passes for 60 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions while adding three rushes for 13 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jakobi Meyers: Paces pass catchers in win
items.body_text: Meyers brought in four of six targets for 65 yards in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens on Thursday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Trevor Lawrence: Solid numbers in comfortable win
items.body_text: Lawrence completed 16 of 26 passes for 242 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions while rushing once for minus-1 yard in the Jaguars' 33-16 win over the Ravens on Thursday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
